steps.name: Environment setup and persistent env vars
steps.description: Create the workspace, validate node/npm presence and Node >=16, compute npm global bin and persist NODE_ENV and PORT plus NPM_GLOBAL_BIN into /etc/profile.d/web_mobileclient_env.sh so future shells see the tools. Source the file for immediate effect.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/create-a-notes-app-246231-247374/Web/MobileClient"
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE"
command -v node >/dev/null && command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "node/npm missing" >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_VER=$(node -v) || true
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -e "console.log(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])") || true
if [ -z "${NODE_MAJOR:-}" ] || [ "${NODE_MAJOR##* }" -lt 16 ]; then echo "node>=16 required, found $NODE_VER" >&2; exit 3; fi
echo "node version: $NODE_VER"
# compute npm global bin value and persist into /etc/profile.d with literal runtime defaults for NODE_ENV/PORT
NPM_GLOBAL_BIN_VALUE=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo '/usr/local/bin')
sudo bash -lc "printf '%s\n' '# persisted env for Web/MobileClient' 'export NODE_ENV=\'\${NODE_ENV:-development}\'' 'export PORT=\'\${PORT:-3000}\'' 'export NPM_GLOBAL_BIN=\'${NPM_GLOBAL_BIN_VALUE}\'' 'if [[ \":\$PATH:\" != *\":\$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN:\"* ]]; then' '  export PATH="\$NPM_GLOBAL_BIN:\$PATH"' 'fi' > /etc/profile.d/web_mobileclient_env.sh"
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/web_mobileclient_env.sh || true
# make available in current shell
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source /etc/profile.d/web_mobileclient_env.sh || true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/create-a-notes-app-246231-247374/Web/MobileClient"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing; scaffold step should have created it" >&2; exit 4; }
# inject missing deps if needed and record whether changed
CHANGED=0
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{};const req={'react':'^18.2.0','react-dom':'^18.2.0','react-scripts':'^5.0.1'};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(req)){if(!p.dependencies[k] && !(p.devDependencies && p.devDependencies[k])){p.dependencies[k]=req[k];changed=true;}}if(changed){fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));process.exit(0);}process.exit(1);" || CHANGED=1
# if package.json changed and package-lock.json exists, remove it so npm install regenerates consistent lockfile
if [ "$CHANGED" -eq 0 ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then :; else
  if [ "$CHANGED" -eq 0 ]; then :; fi
fi
if [ "$CHANGED" -eq 0 ] && [ -f package-lock.json ]; then rm -f package-lock.json || true; fi
# install reproducibly if lock exists else install and generate lockfile
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent; fi
# ensure minimal scripts exist
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';p.scripts.test=p.scripts.test||'react-scripts test --watchAll=false';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));"
# verify react-scripts installed
if [ ! -d node_modules/react-scripts ]; then npx --no-install react-scripts --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "react-scripts not found after install" >&2; exit 5; }; fi
# print minimal tool versions on success (kept minimal)
node --version || true; npm --version || true; npm bin -g || true

steps.name: Validate production build and headless dev server (build -> start -> healthcheck -> stop)
steps.description: Build production artifact (npm run build) to validate build pipeline. Start CRA dev server headless (BROWSER=none HOST=127.0.0.1) in its own session, perform HTTP healthcheck via curl, then terminate process group cleanly and verify port closed using ss/netstat/lsof fallback.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/create-a-notes-app-246231-247374/Web/MobileClient"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# source persisted env if present
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
[ -f /etc/profile.d/web_mobileclient_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/web_mobileclient_env.sh || true
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
# build production artifact
npm run build --silent || { echo "build failed" >&2; exit 7; }
# start dev server in new session so we can kill whole process group
SETSID_LOG="$WORKSPACE/dev-start.log"
setsid env NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=none HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT="$PORT" npm start >"$SETSID_LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$PID" | tr -d ' ')
# wait for server to become responsive (max 30s)
SUCCESS=0
for i in {1..30}; do sleep 1; HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$HTTP_STATUS" ] && [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 200 ]; then SUCCESS=1; break; fi; done
if [ "$SUCCESS" -ne 1 ]; then echo "server did not respond; tail of log:" >&2; tail -n 200 "$SETSID_LOG" >&2 || true; kill -- -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 8; fi
echo "validation: server responding (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS) at http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
# terminate process group cleanly
kill -TERM -- -"$PGID" || kill -- -"$PGID" || true
sleep 2
# verify port closed using available tool fallback
CLOSED=0
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -ltn "sport = :$PORT" | grep -q LISTEN || CLOSED=1; elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then netstat -ltn | grep -q ":$PORT" || CLOSED=1; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep -q ":$PORT" || CLOSED=1; else CLOSED=1; fi
if [ "$CLOSED" -ne 1 ]; then echo "port $PORT still listening" >&2; exit 9; fi
# small evidence snippet
echo "dev-start log tail:"
tail -n 40 "$SETSID_LOG" || true
